I couldn't set up the daily 09:00 digest, so I haven't scheduled anything.

Scheduled jobs in this setup save their output but don't deliver it to a DM, so nothing would reach Kwame tomorrow morning. I posted two messages in DGBRAIN0002. The first wrongly said I had no scheduler at all, and the second corrected that. Kwame can ask for a digest of #coastal-team whenever he wants one, and I can post it in that DM. An automatic version would need someone with delivery-capable scheduling access.
